jobs.name: daily-company-brief
jobs.task: Prepare the daily company brief: active work, blockers, approvals required, and the next important action. Verify current evidence before reporting.

jobs.name: weekly-planning
jobs.task: Prepare the weekly plan. Reconcile current priorities, assign justified Herdr lanes, and report owners, evidence, risks, and expected outcomes.

jobs.name: weekly-executive-report
jobs.task: Prepare the weekly executive report with verified accomplishments, unresolved risks, decisions, and next-week actions.

jobs.name: monthly-revenue-report
jobs.task: Prepare the monthly revenue and operating report. Label mock data, preserve metric lineage, and separate facts, interpretations, decisions, and risks.
